guide.title: CSS Strategy & Architecture
guide.desc: WIM UI adopts modern CSS techniques to achieve high maintainability and collision-free styling.
guide.sass_desc: Powerful features like nesting, variables, and mixins.
guide.layers_desc: WIM UI uses layers to clarify CSS priority.
guide.desc_general: Basic elements such as Button, Icon, InputBase.
guide.desc_complex: Higher-level components such as Snackbar, List.
guide.layers_benefit: Benefit: Non-layer styles always take precedence over styles within layers, allowing base component styles to be overridden without using `!important`.
guide.external_access_rule: The root element of a component is given a `:global(.wim-[ComponentName])` class to allow users to override styles externally.
guide.method_tokens_usage: Adjust themes by overriding CSS variables whenever possible.
guide.method_classname_usage: Styles can be injected externally through each component's `className` prop.
guide.method_global_usage: Target `:global` classes for global adjustments at the application level.
